question.text: As per SEBI's June 21, 2023 circular, units representing unit capital held by investors in Chambal Managed Futures Fund must be issued in which mode?

answer.text: Only in physical certificate form, to preserve the 'trust indenture' bilateralism.
Either demat or physical at the investor's option, as stated in the Subscription Agreement.
In demat mode only for FPIs; resident investors may opt for physical.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.4 (footnote to SEBI circular SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD1/CIR/2023/96 dated June 21, 2023) requires that units of the AIF be issued in dematerialised mode only. Unit statements flow from the depository to the investor periodically — a compliance measure to protect investor interest. The Trap: Options A, B, D all permit a physical-issuance route that the demat-only rule has eliminated. Note: Page 229 of the workbook contains the demat-unit statement rule; page 405 supports dematerialised AIF-unit issuance.
